_comment: Circle Agent Wallet config for the agent. Copy to wallet-config.json and fill in your values. NON-SECRET — no private key, no OTP, no session token ever goes here. Supports 1F3D9 (City fees) and 1F3EA (Market tools/artifacts). Until mode is 'autonomous-approved' AND enabled is true, the harness keeps all money actions OFF.

session.note: Circle sessions expire; re-auth by human email OTP. the market server checks `circle wallet status` before any paid purchase and disables money actions if the session is expired/missing.
